description.value: Doe Coffee Roasters is a community-focused Vancouver café that small-batch roasts its own beans on-site and bakes all pastries fresh in-house overnight. The shop has removed tipping at checkout as a deliberate policy, and its Doe Pass subscription model reflects an unusually loyal neighbourhood following. A reviewer notes at least two locations — the original East Hastings spot and a newer Clarke Street outpost — suggesting growing local presence.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (12 spaces, covered) at 61m. Total: 12 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms Doe Coffee is an active, multi-location Vancouver café with locally roasted coffee, in-house pastries, and an 'Order Online' feature confirming takeout. The menu explicitly labels the 'Green Goddess (Veg)' sandwich, confirming at least one vegetarian option. None of the three required WWC criteria — bike parking, water bottle refill, or washrooms — are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, leaving all three as null.
concerns: No phone number in OSM or on website — contact options are limited to the Doe App and online ordering.
Website references a second location ('Clarke' street) not represented in this OSM record; the East Hastings record should be kept distinct.
Address on website is not explicitly stated; OSM address (2263 East Hastings) is corroborated only by reviewer references to 'E Hastings location', not a formal address listing.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Doe Coffee is an active, welcoming neighbourhood café that would appeal to touring cyclists, but all three required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are unconfirmed from available evidence. An in-person or follow-up verification of these basics is needed before including.
